# cohort-isp-01 source-surface writer FILE baseline — membership only.
#
# Format: `<family>|<path>`. Generated by
# `python -m scripts.architecture.isp_cohort_writers --baseline files`.
#
# Two-directional. A file that starts writing cohort state fails the
# guard; so does a baselined file that stopped, until its line is
# deleted in the same change. Delete a line only in the pull request
# that actually removes the writer, after the sealed authority switch.
#
# Counts live in isp_cohort1_write_sites_baseline.txt. This file says
# nothing about how much a writer writes, on purpose.
#
# 2026-08-22 — `service|app/services/gis_sync.py` ADDED deliberately. It is
# not a new parallel writer: `gis.spatial_sync` is the declared owner of an
# address coordinate and its map projection, and this is the first release in
# which it actually performs that write instead of leaving it to callers.
# `customer_location_requests` fell 6 sites to 1 in the same change and the
# total fell 101 -> 99, so the surface shrank while ownership concentrated.
# The census is authority-blind by design; it counts files, not owners.
#
# 2026-09-11 — `service|app/services/customer_canonical_profile_patch.py`
# ADDED deliberately. It is the registered `customer.canonical_profile_patch`
# participant, isolated from `customer.accounts`, and applies only an explicit
# typed field set inside its calling coordinator's transaction.
